map.个股与市场反方向运动（如部分避险资产），市场跌时它涨。实际较少见，多出现在特定对: The stock and the market move in opposite directions (as with some safe-haven assets): the stock rises when the market falls. This is actually rare and mostly appears in specific hedge portfolios.
map.Beta 系数 β = 协方差 Cov(rᵢ, rₘ) ÷ 市场方差 Varₘ（: Beta coefficient β = covariance Cov(rᵢ, rₘ) ÷ market variance Varₘ (main formula, 3 decimal places); additional reference cards: Cov × Varₘ (scientific notation), systematic risk = β² × Varₘ, covariance cross-check = β × Varₘ. Validation: non-empty numeric guards for covariance and market variance. Criteria: β > 1 moves more than the market, 0 < β < 1 less than the market, β = 1 in sync with the market, β < 0 inverse to the market; the derived cards are for reference only.
